title: Fireflies in sync.
lede: At dusk, fireflies flash alone. Then one finds a rhythm, and the whole forest lights up in time.
intro: Culture moves when the right people find each other. I connect the founders, artists and creatives building worlds in Melbourne and beyond, open doors for them, and pull them into work bigger than any of us could make alone.
leadTitle: Open the doors. Fill the room.
leadText: Every scene that ever moved culture had someone at the centre doing two things. Opening doors, with nothing asked in return. And filling the room: pulling designers, musicians, photographers and directors into one vision, bigger than any of them could make alone. That's the work. The community is where it starts.

roles.name: The connector
roles.line: Holds the door open. Knows who should meet who, and makes it happen before anyone asks. Every intro is a seed. Some grow into labels, tours and careers.

roles.name: The conductor
roles.line: Gets every kind of talent into the same room and points it at one vision. A shoot becomes a film. A drop becomes a night. A collab becomes a movement.

ethosText: Not rules pinned to a wall. Just how it goes when the right people share a room.

ethos.title: Give before you ask.
ethos.text: Value out, trust back. Bring an idea, an intro, a kind word. The door opens wider for the people who hold it open.

ethos.title: Bigger together.
ethos.text: The best work comes from rooms full of different talent pointed at one vision. Bring yours, and leave space for everyone else's.

ethos.title: Taste over trend.
ethos.text: Share what moves you, not what's moving the algorithm. Taste is the currency in here.

ethos.title: Unfinished is welcome.
ethos.text: Post the draft. Honest feedback, given with care, is how good work becomes great work.

ethos.title: Bring someone with you.
ethos.text: Light the path for the next person through the door. That's how a scene becomes a culture.
ethos.practice: IRL nights in Melbourne, when the time is right
